The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown above. Given that $y=f(x)$ is periodic with period $3,$ what is the value of $f(30)?$
questions.worked_solution:
Since the period is $3,$ if we add (or subtract) any multiple of $3$ from the input, the output stays the same.

So, we can keep subtracting $3$ from the input until we get to an input that we see in the graph:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(30) & =f(30-3) \\  & =f(30-2\cdot 3) \\  & =⋯ \\  & =f(30-10\cdot 3) \\  & =f(0) \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$
